 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0).most_common(1)[0][0]
    src = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, bg)]
    dst = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in src), max(r for r, c in src)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in src), max(c for r, c in src)
    dr0, dr1 = min(r for r, c in dst), max(r for r, c in dst)
    dc0, dc1 = min(c for r, c in dst), max(c for r, c in dst)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(dr0, dr1 + 1):
        for c in range(dc0, dc1 + 1):
            out[r][c] = grid[r0 + (r - dr0)][c1 - (c - dc0)]
    return out
